title: Triage this inbound request into one well-specified task: "the app is slow sometimes, pls fix". Write triage/slow-app.md starting with the lines `role: <backend|frontend|review|triage>`, `title: <imperative summary>`, `verify_cmd: <one deterministic command>`, followed by the sections `## Reproduction`, `## Scope` and `## Out of scope` (each non-empty). Do not change any code.
verify_cmd:
python -c 'import pathlib, re
text = pathlib.Path("triage/slow-app.md").read_text()
head = dict(l.split(":", 1) for l in text.splitlines()[:6] if re.match(r"(role|title|verify_cmd):", l))
assert head["role"].strip() in {"backend", "frontend", "review", "triage"}, head
assert len(head["title"].strip()) >= 10 and head["verify_cmd"].strip()
for section in ("Reproduction", "Scope", "Out of scope"):
    body = re.search(rf"^## {section}\s*\n(.*?)(?=^## |\Z)", text, re.S | re.M)
    assert body and body.group(1).strip(), section'
